method: Five parallel researcher agents, one per continental/language cluster (Latin America ES; Europe local languages; MENA + Central Asia AR/RU/FA/HE; Sub-Saharan Africa EN/FR/PT; Asia-Pacific + Caribbean local languages). Per jurisdiction: 2-4 local-language searches for prestressed bridge beams plus an explicit English AASHTO-adoption check. Statuses: IMPLEMENTABLE, AASHTO-ADOPTION, RUSSIAN-ADOPTION, IMPORTED-OTHER, LOCAL-STANDARD, LEAD-NO-DIMS, NONE-FOUND. URLs are only those returned by search results.
